user.title: Connect Inu
user.description: In Inu, open [Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant](https://inuwithyou.com/?page=settings&section=integrations&integration=homeassistant) and create a connection key. Paste it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Inu
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new connection key in Inu Settings and paste it here. Use the same Inu account.

error.invalid_auth: This key is invalid, expired or revoked. Create a new one in Inu Settings.
error.cannot_connect: Inu could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.wrong_account: This key belongs to another Inu account.

abort.already_configured: This Inu account is already connected.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Use this to check off one task in an automation. Enter its full title from Inu, for example Water the plants.

task_name.name: Task name
task_name.description: The full title from Inu, for example Water the plants.

config_entry_id.name: Inu account
config_entry_id.description: Choose an account if you connected more than one.

send_message.name: Send command
send_message.description: Send a text command, for example complete: Water the plants. For a task with a known title, choose Complete task.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Send a note to your Inu inbox. Your PC can show it when notifications are enabled.
